page.notes: Running head (top right) is in heavy decorative type and could not be read; left as illegible. A small dot in the right margin beside "proin-" is a mark, not a note. Faint marks at the lower left are show-through and were left out. "debesi" in "debesi enim" is a doubtful reading and should be checked against the scan: the printed word appears to be "deberi" with the r partly obscured. "superius expositimus" appears as printed; the scan shows "exposuimus" and is likely a misprint for "exposuimus", kept as printed here. "pecunię" and "contrarie" are kept with their printed ę and è; the accents are hard to make out at this resolution. The paragraph continues onto the next page.
